results.detail: verify.ps1 built all targets and passed all four local test executables, including hibiki_contract_tests with the new Issue 1283 multi-bus frame fixtures.
handoff-check #1283 (claimed ownership, scope and Git state), docs-check (88 required paths), source-policy (725 tracked paths), and git diff --check all exited 0 in the isolated worktree.

limitations: Evidence covers the user-space worker protocol wire contract only: multi-bus frame encoding, validation, and per-bus sample slicing for side-chain and auxiliary buses.
It does not demonstrate a live VST3 worker process consuming these frames, WaveRT delivery, kernel mapping, driver installation, HLK validation, or signing.
The provenance digest binds this manifest to the staged SPEC-0008, contract-test and vst-host source set; it does not independently attest that declared commands ran.
